tabbit.processingElapsedStatus: NOT_CAPTURED_IN_ORIGINAL_LARGE_RUN; required in S2 production-equivalent gate

interpretation: The probe keeps bounded input/PCM/output buffers and measures heartbeat through Worker progress/completion. The encode-stage peak is measured; peakBufferedBytes includes a conservative upper bound for Blob chunks, verification arrayBuffer, SHA-256 arrayBuffer and peak PCM. Full output verification uses a bounded first-frame decode plus a complete MP3 frame scan.
